newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi firm to build $61 million epoxy resin plant.
newsitem.headline: Saudi firm to build $61 million epoxy resin plant.

text.p: Arabian Industrial Development Company (NAMA) said on Tuesday it plans to build a 230 million riyal ($61 million) epoxy resin plant in the industrial city of Jubail.
The Saudi Investment Bank (SAIB) said on Monday it had signed an agreement with NAMA to extend a 152 million riyal loan to finance part of the project. No details on the loan terms were given.
The Riyadh-based SAIB is owned by Saudi shareholders and several Saudi and foreign banks including Chase Manhattan Corp and Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd.
Japan's Mitsui Engineering & Shipbuilding Company has been awarded a contract to build the 20,000 tonnes per year plant on a lump-sum, turnkey basis, NAMA said.
